evidence.observation: O2 held at about 5-7 ppm through the purge-to-ramp period
O2 rose steadily during growth: 12, 20.3, 29.2, 34.5, 44.7 ppm, meaning oxygen is getting into the tube
Ar flow on its 100 sccm setpoint, so a stuck flow controller doesn't explain the rise
Thermocouple steady at about 750 °C with normal heater power
Not installed, so the tube atmosphere/pressure can't be checked, though the growth stage requires it

args.missing_evidence: A tube pressure reading or a leak check would separate a seal leak from an exhaust blockage or backflow. Characterization of the sample is also still missing.
